title: A Bi-directional Multi-solution Scalable Grover Search Algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2404.15616v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Grover's search algorithms, including various Partial Grover Searches (PGS), suffer from scaling issues when multiple solutions are sought, as the number of iterations scales with the number of solutions or marked states, making implementation more computationally expensive. Inspired by recent PGS algorithms for multi-solution searchers, this article proposes a scalable Grover quantum search algorithm, referred to as Bi-directional Multi-solution scalable Grover Search (BMGS), to efficiently search for an arbitrary number of solutions from an unstructured database. translated_title: 一种双向多解可扩展的Grover搜索算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2404.15616v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：Grover搜索算法，包括各种部分Grover搜索（PGS），在寻找多个解时面临扩展性问题，因为迭代次数随解的数量或标记状态的数量而扩展，使得实现的计算成本更高。受最近用于多解搜索的PGS算法启发，本文提出了一种可扩展的Grover量子搜索算法，称为双向多解可扩展Grover搜索（BMGS），以高效地从非结构化数据库中搜索任意数量的解。我们引入了一种新颖的多段双向搜索策略，结合PGS在每个状态的多个等分段上，从初始状态和多个标记状态并行开始，无需合并操作。本工作中我们表明，对于每个解，我们的新方法最多需要$\sqrt{\mathcal{N}}\left (1- \sqrt{\frac{1}{b^{\lflo}} \right)$次迭代。
tldr: 本文提出了一种双向多解可扩展的Grover搜索算法（BMGS），通过多段并行双向搜索策略，无需合并操作即可高效搜索任意数量的解，显著降低了迭代成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bi-directional Multi-solution scalable Grover Search (BMGS) algorithm, which uses a multi-segment parallel bidirectional search strategy without merge operations to efficiently search for any number of solutions, significantly reducing iteration costs.
